modelProviderEndpointsHint: Optional per-protocol endpoint overrides. Leave blank to derive URLs from the Base URL and endpoint format.
modelProviderFailoverDisabledHint: Combine multiple providers into one resilient route. Accounts and fallback providers share the group.
modelProviderFailoverStrategyDesc_smart: Stick to one account within a conversation to preserve cache; switch to the account with the most remaining quota when it runs low or fails; use fallbacks only when every account is unavailable.
modelProviderFailoverStrategyDesc_order: Always use the first account; move to the next only when it is unavailable; try fallbacks last.
modelProviderFailoverStrategyDesc_rotate: Rotate to the next account on every request, which lowers cache hit rate; use fallbacks only when every account is unavailable.
modelProviderFailoverStrategyDesc_least-: Prefer the account with the least recent usage; use fallbacks only when every account is unavailable.
modelProviderFailoverFallbacksHint: Other providers tried when every account fails.
modelProviderFailoverMemberHint: This provider is a member of the failover group.
modelProviderFailoverInvalidFallback: provider or model removed — ignored at runtime
modelProviderImportDesc: Scan local tool configurations (CC Switch, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) and import matching providers. Credentials are read in the main process and never shown here.
modelProviderImportEmpty: No importable provider configurations were found.
modelProviderImportKeyNote: Keys stay in the main process.
modelProviderPasteLinkInvalid: The link is not a valid Kun provider import link.
modelProviderLinkImportDesc: Review the provider details before adding it. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
modelProviderLinkImportWarning: Prompts and your API key will be sent to {{host}}. Only continue if you trust this destination.
modelProviderIconHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, at most 1 MB.
modelProviderIconTooLarge: Icon files must be at most 1 MB.
modelProviderCatalogSourcesHint: Comma-separated models.dev provider keys consulted for model metadata, first match wins.
modelProviderKeyOptionalHint: Optional — this provider accepts keyless access
modelProviderDetectCostHint: Detection sends one minimal request per format and may consume a few tokens.
modelProviderFailoverOauthStrategyHint: Subscription (OAuth) accounts do not support rotate or least-used; they automatically run with the smart strategy.
